title: Yellow Earthy Japanese Beef Zenzai
description: A hearty one-pot Japanese dish featuring tender beef, sweet medjool dates, and a rich earthy sauce, all made in a dairy-free friendly zenzai style. This dish is perfect for a cold winter evening.

ingredients.name: beef brisket
ingredients.notes: rested meat, sliced into thin strips

instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, sake, mirin, and mushroom broth to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the pitted medjool dates to the pot and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes.
Stir in the yellow miso paste until well combined.
Continue to simmer the mixture for an additional 5 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the beef is tender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the zenzai hot, garnished with thinly sliced scallions.
